Jyeṣṭhā
(‘the elder one’)
------------------------------------------
See ALAKṢMĪ.
In Hindu अस्त्रोलोग्य्, it is the 18th नक्षत्र or constellation. The स्तर्स् of this group are: alpha, sigma, and tau scorpii. It has a malefic influence. Persons born when the मोओन् is in this नक्षत्र are assigned to the rākṣasagaṇa, prone to violence and quarrels.
